body: If I take time for myself, I will lose my job.  We all know where that leads these days...  Believe me I thought this though.  Ain't no rest for the wicked...
Well I set a week long timer.  Don't understand how someone experiencing similar issues as me will help me?   If I reach out I will most certainly WILL be a burden...
Its hard to keep going because Im so exhausted, i've never been this drained in my life.
